scope: Independent requirements audit of the complete project transcript available to the agent, reconciled against repository evidence only. No production state was mutated.

status_legend.FINAL_DECISION: The user made a later decision that supersedes earlier alternatives.
status_legend.USER_CONFIRMED_ACCEPTANCE: The user explicitly observed and accepted the result.
status_legend.USER_REPORTED_DEFECT: The user explicitly reported that the result was absent or wrong.
status_legend.REQUESTED_UNVERIFIED: The user requested it but did not confirm completion.
status_legend.ASSISTANT_CLAIM_ONLY: Prior assistant or repository documentation claims progress; the user did not confirm it.
status_legend.MIXED: Some portions were accepted while other required portions remain unverified.
status_legend.SUPERSEDED: A later user instruction removed this from the target architecture.

evidence_policy: User observation outranks assistant statements. Repository code, tests, manifests, and documents are claimed evidence only until a fresh runtime readback and, where applicable, user-visible UI review proves the result.

requirements.title: n8n is the sole production scheduler and orchestrator
requirements.requirement: Replace standalone Codex scheduling and the retired bridge with n8n-owned schedules, cursor-safe acquisition, visible ETL, durable receipts, and bounded AI handoff.
requirements.expected_state: All production workflows run from n8n; Codex tasks remain only until each issuer workflow passes cutover gates; no legacy HTTP bridge, SSH submission wrapper, or finance-worker compatibility path exists.
acceptance_criteria: Exact n8n image imports and executes all non-placeholder workflows
Three consecutive shadow runs and one guarded write per active issuer
Legacy bridge/runtime and Codex issuer schedule are absent only after cutover
n8n durable receipts prove each run
contradictions: Earlier design used standalone Codex schedules and a host-side ingestion bridge; this is superseded
Current Codex schedules intentionally remain active until n8n replacement acceptance, so the target is not deployed
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user asked to simplify scheduled agents, questioned hardcoded SSH, then directed a greenfield n8n architecture; current AGENTS.md makes n8n the owner.

requirements.title: Workflow stages remain visible and composable
requirements.requirement: Use native n8n nodes and subworkflows for acquisition, OneDrive archive, hashing, PDF extraction, normalization, rules, AI, reconciliation, Actual write, cursor commit, and close instead of one opaque worker call.
requirements.expected_state: Workflow canvases visibly expose financial stages; fixed-purpose custom nodes exist only for unsafe or unsupported operations.
acceptance_criteria: Imported canvas shows each required stage
No generic Execute Command or SSH node
Each subworkflow has a schema and terminal receipt
A reviewer can follow source to write without reading application code
claimed_evidence: Twenty-one workflow JSON exports exist under integrations/n8n/workflows
contradictions: Older Python/TypeScript worker designs bundled several stages; target now requires visible orchestration
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user repeatedly asked to offload ordinary logic to platform-native functionality and later authorized n8n as the visible orchestration layer.

requirements.title: Cursor-safe Outlook acquisition
requirements.requirement: Freeze run_upper_bound, scan from the last successful cursor minus overlap, exhaust pagination, record exact scanned count including zero-message heartbeats, and advance once only after durable downstream success.
requirements.expected_state: Late, duplicate, out-of-order, 101-plus, empty, and failed scans never skip mail or advance a cursor early.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures cover zero, 101-plus, late, duplicate, out-of-order and pagination failure
One aggregate result and one cursor commit per sweep
Runtime receipt contains frozen window and exact counts
claimed_evidence: Prior RAK runs were reported successful with cursor verification
contradictions: Initial hourly/twice-daily proposals were later reduced to morning-only live scans
Successful legacy/Codex cursor runs do not prove the n8n implementation
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user explicitly corrected the scanner to remember last successful ingestion time and use a buffer.

requirements.title: Postgres and Data Tables hold operational state only
requirements.requirement: Use Postgres-backed n8n state for cursors, leases, outbox, receipts, document states, circuit breakers, configuration versions, and failures without creating a second finance ledger.
requirements.expected_state: Actual is the only posted ledger; companion SQLite is the only live cashback event store; Postgres contains no duplicate transaction ledger.
acceptance_criteria: No posted finance rows are queryable from Postgres as an alternate ledger
Restore drill preserves state and encryption key
Operational rows have idempotency and retention rules
contradictions: The earliest discussion considered SQLite as raw financial storage and Notion as the data store; both are superseded for posted transactions
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user asked whether SQLite was required, later removed Notion entirely, selected Actual, and finally selected n8n/Postgres for orchestration state only.

requirements.title: Single fenced Actual writer and recoverable outbox
requirements.requirement: All Actual mutations pass through one fixed-purpose writer with a process-independent lease, deterministic imported IDs, pre/post sync, returned-error checks, exact readback, and recoverable outbox states.
requirements.expected_state: Concurrent or interrupted runs produce one ledger row, one verified outbox commit, and one cursor advance.
acceptance_criteria: PREPARED to ACTUAL_OBSERVED to VERIFIED to COMMITTED transitions are durable
contradictions: Earlier direct browser or bridge writes are superseded
Repository exports and tests are not production proof
requirements.source_turn_summary: The architecture converged on a single guarded Actual write path after repeated concerns about fragile ingestion and duplicate data.

requirements.title: Production workflows start inactive and write-disabled
requirements.requirement: Every workflow must progress through SPEC_ONLY, disposable tests, shadow mode, reviewed delta, guarded write, and production activation.
requirements.expected_state: No production workflow or finance write is enabled merely because JSON imports or unit tests pass.
acceptance_criteria: Registry status and live activation agree
contradictions: Earlier user grants of full authority to deploy services do not waive the later finance-write safety gate
requirements.source_turn_summary: Later project instructions establish repository-only work as GO and production write/deployment as NO-GO until gates pass.

requirements.title: Bounded operations and error workflows
requirements.requirement: Provide redacted error handling, stale-cursor detection, statement-deadline alerts, recovery operations, status receipts, and no sensitive execution payload retention.
requirements.expected_state: Every production workflow has a real terminal receipt and attached error workflow; sensitive payloads are excluded from success and failure history.
acceptance_criteria: Induced failures create redacted durable failures
No PDF bytes, decrypted text, passwords or tokens appear in execution history
Status workflow reports source, cursor, freshness and blocker
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user asked to automate as much as possible and later required production validation and unattended continuation; safe operations and failure visibility are necessary acceptance conditions.

requirements.title: Native-node-first and reviewed extension policy
requirements.requirement: Prefer built-in Outlook, OneDrive, Data Table, ETL, MCP, HTTP, and file nodes; isolate and review only narrow custom finance/PDF nodes.
requirements.expected_state: No unreviewed community node runs in the finance trust boundary; exact packages are pinned, scanned, and smoke-tested.
acceptance_criteria: Community pilot cannot access production credentials or write Actual
contradictions: Earlier inquiry considered broad SDKs/plugins; the reviewed decision is narrow built-ins plus fixed-purpose nodes
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user asked about SDKs, native functionality, scripting, plugins and modules, then moved to n8n and requested reusable components.

requirements.title: Bounded MCP facade
requirements.requirement: Expose only fixed finance operation codes for status, reviewed artifact handoff, and document request; keep instance-level unrestricted MCP disabled.
requirements.expected_state: Unknown, write-capable, caller-selected path/ID/URL/command, and unauthenticated requests are rejected.
acceptance_criteria: Positive and negative Service Auth tests
No general Actual writer or workflow-authoring tool exposed
Receipts can be polled to a terminal state
contradictions: Earlier Actual MCP/community-server exploration did not establish a safe production mutation surface
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user wanted direct Codex access and evaluated Actual/MoneyMatter MCP; the current architecture narrows this to an operations facade.

requirements.title: Immutable OneDrive evidence archive
requirements.requirement: Store statements, receipts, bills, warranties, message snapshots, and extracted documents under Finance Evidence/YYYY/MM/vendor-slug with deterministic filenames and catalogue metadata.
requirements.expected_state: The encrypted original is immutable; catalogue entries retain source identity, hash, transaction link, document type, property, warranty and expiry metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Every saved file path follows AGENTS.md naming
SHA-256 and OneDrive item identity read back
No browser session secret is stored
Catalogue links resolve from ledger records
claimed_evidence: Finance Evidence catalogue was previously claimed to contain statement artifacts
contradictions: Early discussion considered Notion uploads; latest decision is OneDrive archive and no Notion dependency
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user explicitly requested a structured year/month/vendor directory, recognizable filenames, automatic attachments, and a searchable document database.

requirements.title: Local secure PDF unlock and extraction
requirements.requirement: Use statement-specific password credentials to validate/unlock PDFs locally, then native extraction and deterministic parser/profile validation; quarantine unsupported or ambiguous documents.
requirements.expected_state: Passwords never appear in workflow payloads; decrypted artifacts are ephemeral; external PDF providers are disabled absent document-specific approval.
acceptance_criteria: Encrypted EI/ADCB and synthetic fixtures pass
PDF utility is unprivileged, read-only and networkless
No decrypted text persists in executions
contradictions: Earlier direct local scripts and possible SaaS parsing are superseded as the default path
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user supplied statement passwords, asked how decryption works without stored passwords, and later approved 1Password-backed runtime injection.

requirements.title: Selective receipts, bills, warranties, and purchase-proof acquisition
requirements.requirement: Search mail for document-worthy or high-value durable purchases using vendor aliases, amount/currency, and date buffer; skip routine consumables and weak vendor-only matches.
requirements.expected_state: Evidence policy is configurable; AI may propose a search but deterministic matching and review decide storage.
acceptance_criteria: High-value unknown product searches use vendor plus price and period
Do-not-store categories remain excluded unless manually requested
contradictions: An earlier broad request to search mail for every transaction was narrowed to selective, valuable evidence
Refunds and ordinary payment reminders are not part of the daily live scan
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user corrected the agent not to store proof for trivial purchases and required category/product examples plus value thresholds.

requirements.title: Transaction-to-email and document links
requirements.requirement: Any relevant transaction type/category can request related-mail search and retain both the message reference and linked transaction document.
requirements.expected_state: Actual notes contain only concise human links/tags; technical message IDs and hashes live in evidence metadata, not display notes.
acceptance_criteria: Display notes contain no raw message hash
contradictions: Earlier verbose notes embedded message hashes; the user explicitly rejected that format
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user required email references and document links for transactions, then demanded minimal standardized notes.

requirements.title: Utility bill extraction and property matching
requirements.requirement: Extract DEWA, Empower, service-charge and similar bill PDFs, match exact amounts to statement transactions, and classify home versus rental using email/property evidence.
requirements.expected_state: Amount-only guesses are forbidden; accepted matches apply property/unit metadata and correct rental/home tags.
acceptance_criteria: Property identity comes from explicit bill/email evidence
Home and rental tags are mutually exclusive
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user explicitly asked to extract utility PDFs, match amounts, and allocate costs dynamically to home or rental units.

requirements.title: Amazon order enrichment and evidence-backed split
requirements.requirement: Use authenticated Amazon/order email data to enrich purchases and split one card transaction into orders only when item/order totals reconcile exactly to the statement amount.
requirements.expected_state: Ambiguous or zero-total orders remain unmatched; no speculative split is written.
acceptance_criteria: Stable order references and evidence links
Unmatched multi-order transaction remains intact and reviewable
claimed_evidence: docs/historical-import-audit-2026-08-18.md reports some order matches and unresolved zero totals
contradictions: The user requested splitting at ingestion; safety policy later limits it to exact evidence-backed equations
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user asked for Amazon enrichment and multi-order splitting while earlier architecture required fail-closed combined-payment reconciliation.

requirements.title: Source deduplication, quarantine, and immutable receipts
requirements.requirement: Hash sources and attachments, suppress only explicit cross-source duplicates, quarantine parse/reconciliation failures, and never advance financial state from quarantined input.
requirements.expected_state: Every source has one immutable archive identity and a replay-safe terminal receipt.
acceptance_criteria: No cursor or Actual write on failed validation
claimed_evidence: Legacy and rebuilt pipelines were reported to have deterministic dedupe/reconciliation
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user consistently required reliable scheduled ingestion and later a full clean replay; strict source identity is an invariant inherited from the original app review.

requirements.title: AI runs only after deterministic rules and history matching
requirements.requirement: Parse and normalize, apply ordered static rules, then vendor/history matching; invoke AI only for unresolved allowed fields.
requirements.expected_state: AI never overrides locks, amounts, source IDs, direction/topic, dedupe keys, reconciliation, or cashback arithmetic.
acceptance_criteria: AI outage yields review items rather than invented values
contradictions: Earlier notion of AI rules intermingled with static rules; user later favored separate engines
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user explicitly asked whether static and AI rules should be separate and later confirmed AI categorization/tagging after deterministic rules.

requirements.title: Luna normal path and gated Sol exception path
requirements.requirement: Use gpt-5.6-luna max for normal bounded enrichment and gpt-5.6-sol medium only for high-confidence category/rule/property exceptions.
requirements.expected_state: The caller selects a trusted policy class, not an arbitrary model; model/effort mapping is server-owned.
acceptance_criteria: Normal and exception receipts show forced model mapping
contradictions: Earlier daily tasks displayed Sol medium and the user corrected them to Luna max; monthly statement tasks still intentionally use Sol medium
The n8n AI exception path uses Sol medium, which is separate from monthly deterministic reconciliation
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user questioned Terra quality, requested Luna for lightweight scans, and preferred one stronger agent only where needed.

requirements.title: Direct subscription proposal adapter
requirements.requirement: Run one bounded ChatGPT-subscription proposal through the pinned Workflow 21 adapter with a fixed schema, fixed operation, and no caller command/prompt/path/URL.
requirements.expected_state: Only schema-valid proposals return to n8n; n8n revalidates and never lets the provider write finance state directly.
acceptance_criteria: Malicious output and protected fields rejected
ChatGPT login forced and API-key fallback forbidden
contradictions: The earlier dedicated-runner design is superseded by direct pinned Workflow 21 subscription nodes
Scheduled-task subagents are superseded by workflow-level fixed AI calls
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user asked whether a scheduled orchestrator could use subagents/models and emphasized Codex subscription access rather than an in-container API model.

requirements.title: AI category and rule recommendations remain proposals
requirements.requirement: When no category fits, propose a new category/group; when repeated reviewed examples exist, propose a disabled static rule. Do not create either automatically.
requirements.expected_state: Review records include confidence and evidence; owner approval updates configuration and reruns classification.
acceptance_criteria: At least three consistent reviewed examples for rule proposal
Rejected proposal has no ledger effect
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user asked whether unmatched categories should generate a recommendation and wanted reusable AI instructions without uncontrolled schema mutation.

requirements.title: Community AI nodes are optional, pinned pilots only
requirements.requirement: Do not make ProDex or another community node a production dependency unless code, token lifecycle, lockfile, SBOM, structured-output behavior, and isolation are reviewed.
requirements.expected_state: The fixed subscription adapter is the supported ChatGPT-subscription path; official OpenAI nodes remain API-key alternatives only.
acceptance_criteria: No unreviewed community package in production image
Token never enters n8n execution data
Optional pilot cannot mutate finance systems
contradictions: Earlier the user considered OpenRouter budget models; current requirement favors ChatGPT subscription through a bounded runner but retains provider-neutral contracts
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user evaluated multiple AI paths and asked whether stronger models/subagents could be orchestrated without a separate bridge.

requirements.title: Actual is the sole authoritative finance ledger
requirements.requirement: Actual owns posted transactions, accounts, categories, payees, budgets, schedules, rules, reconciliation, and ordinary reports.
requirements.expected_state: No Notion or SQLite duplicate ledger; companion and n8n hold only their scoped operational state.
acceptance_criteria: Every posted source identity exists exactly once in Actual
Operational stores contain no authoritative duplicate row
Actual readback is part of every write receipt
contradictions: All Notion data/rule/dashboard requirements were explicitly superseded by 'remove dependency on notion entirely. No migration.'
requirements.source_turn_summary: The project moved from Notion POC to Actual after platform evaluation; the user explicitly told the agent to drop Notion entirely.

requirements.title: Complete account inventory for FAB non-credit accounts and Sarwa portfolios
requirements.requirement: Create exactly one stable account record for every FAB non-credit account and intended Sarwa portfolio captured from authoritative portals.
requirements.expected_state: FAB deposit/mortgage accounts and active Sarwa Invest/Trade portfolios exist with stable provider IDs, type, currency, last4 where applicable, lifecycle, owner, off-budget and net-worth flags; closed Sarwa Classic is inventoried but excluded.
acceptance_criteria: Expected inventory equals Actual account set
claimed_evidence: The user reported all non-card accounts and Sarwa missing
config/account-completeness.json now inventories FAB and Sarwa
config/project-acceptance.json still marks fab and Sarwa requirements PARTIAL
contradictions: Earlier audits only knew FAB 2001; a later repository capture inventories additional FAB accounts, but production readback is not user-confirmed
Legacy workbook is explicitly excluded as an account recovery source
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user said all accounts besides credit cards were missing, specifically Sarwa, and narrowed recovery to FAB non-credit plus all Sarwa accounts.

requirements.title: Explainable balances, net worth, and UI/API parity
requirements.requirement: Actual UI and API must show the same file, account IDs, transactions, signed balances, and All Accounts/net-worth total, reconciled to timestamped FAB/Sarwa/FX evidence.
requirements.expected_state: Every balance equation is reproducible; assets are positive, liabilities negative, and stale wealth is flagged.
acceptance_criteria: UI and API sync IDs and account hashes equal
Sarwa USD plus approved FX reconciles
All Accounts equation is published with no unexplained adjustment
claimed_evidence: Prior audit found live UI/API divergence and missing FAB opening state
config/project-acceptance.json marks actual-ui-api-parity BLOCKED and wealth-net-worth PARTIAL
contradictions: Later repository plans propose reconciliation adjustments; those are not authoritative bank activity and require reviewed evidence
A prior assistant claim of a clean ledger did not include complete accounts/net worth
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user explicitly rejected the negative All Accounts value and asked where Sarwa and other accounts were.

requirements.title: Statement-agnostic bank adapter contract
requirements.requirement: Place any bank behind a normalized statement API with pluggable parser profiles, stable source IDs, direction semantics, reconciliation and quarantine.
requirements.expected_state: ADCB, EI and Wio have real fixtures; RAK and SC remain placeholders until representative statements and mailbox contracts pass tests.
acceptance_criteria: No issuer-specific behavior leaks into core code
claimed_evidence: User specifically requested an abstraction API
contradictions: ADCB recurring ingestion was later dropped because the card is closed
RAK/SC monthly tasks exist only as non-importing placeholders
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user explicitly said an abstraction API was needed so any bank could normalize into the pipeline.

requirements.title: AutoCat-style ordered static rules
requirements.requirement: Support staged pre/default/post rules, any condition group with all conditions inside, ascending priority, One Of and regex operators, multiple actions, locks, and same-stage stop-on-match.
requirements.expected_state: Canonical JSON is the portable DSL; representable rules compile to Actual without semantic loss and remaining deterministic rules execute exactly once upstream.
acceptance_criteria: Tiller/original patterns inspire but are not copied wholesale
contradictions: An early single compiled expression model was rejected as weaker than AutoCat
User asked to combine simple merchant rules with One Of rather than create many rules
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user repeatedly asked for Tiller-like AutoCat behavior, combined conditions, regex for pharmacies/supermarkets, and pre/default/post semantics.

requirements.title: Exclusive rule ownership between Actual and upstream evaluator
requirements.requirement: Execute each deterministic rule/action in exactly one place: Actual for losslessly representable AutoCat rules and upstream only for non-representable normalization/source semantics.
requirements.expected_state: Compiler parity passes and no action can be applied twice.
acceptance_criteria: Actual and canonical evaluator parity fixtures
contradictions: Earlier aim to execute all rules natively in Notion is superseded
Earlier bridge could apply rules before Actual; target must prevent duplicate Actual post-rules
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user wanted maximum Actual-native rule use while keeping normalization and AI outside Actual.

requirements.title: Payee and transaction normalization preserves originals
requirements.requirement: Normalize imported merchant strings before import where deterministic, use Actual Payee Name semantics for display, and preserve original imported payee in source metadata.
requirements.expected_state: Broad safe normalizers reduce rule count; ambiguous payees remain reviewable; display names are clean without losing auditability.
acceptance_criteria: No hundreds of redundant exact rules
claimed_evidence: User reported many payees still need normalization
contradictions: Actual automatic payee learning can create exact pre-rules, but user-owned pipeline should avoid competing duplicates
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user asked the difference between payee and payee name and preferred normalization at ingestion rather than hundreds of rules.

requirements.title: Scoped AI classification and tagging
requirements.requirement: Use AI after static/history matching for unresolved vendor, category, subcategory, approved tags, property, subscription, evidence policy and cashback channel/bucket.
requirements.expected_state: Every unresolved row is either safely proposed with confidence or present in one explicit review queue.
acceptance_criteria: Coverage equation unresolved equals review queue
No large AI explanation in notes
contradictions: Hourly cashback classification is intentionally a small bucket-only subset, not the full budgeting classifier
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user confirmed AI categorization/tagging should exist and asked for richer rules after the static engine.

requirements.title: Category and subcategory management
requirements.requirement: Maintain useful category groups and subcategories, allow reviewed AI recommendations for missing categories, and avoid automatic schema creation.
requirements.expected_state: Categories support budgeting/reporting and inherit shared/property/refund rules where logical.
acceptance_criteria: No imported legacy taxonomy without review
contradictions: User explicitly said not to import current AutoCat categories wholesale; use them as inspiration
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user asked for category/subcategory management and AI proposals rather than blind migration.

requirements.title: Correct purchase, refund, reward, transfer, fee and interest semantics
requirements.requirement: Classify topic and direction before categorization; positive merchant credits default to refunds unless explicit transfer/reward evidence; card payments are transfers and source sign is normalized at the adapter boundary.
requirements.expected_state: EI Amazon statement refunds are not cashback; Amazon cashback exists as Amazon credits; card-payment transfers do not distort spend or balances.
acceptance_criteria: Known EI AED 3.55 and AED 2.57 credits classify as refunds
Transfer direction and paired-account matching tests
Rules cannot change amount sign after source normalization
contradictions: Earlier rules tagged positive EI Amazon entries as #cashback-ei_amazon; user said that is wrong
User asked about using formulas to flip sign; later safety decision moved sign normalization to adapter boundary
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user identified refunds labeled cashback and incoming card payments ingested as spending, demanding topic-aware rules.

requirements.title: Canonical minimal tags-first display notes
requirements.requirement: Prepend normalized tags, then optional concise human text/evidence links; remove source labels, message hashes, parser bookkeeping, routine original currency/amount, evidence boilerplate, #browser-import, #primary, redundant cashback tags and duplicates.
requirements.expected_state: All production notes pass one grammar, ordering, forbidden-token, case and dedupe test and match the visible UI.
acceptance_criteria: Technical FX data remains in manifests, not display notes
User-visible spot check after fresh sync
claimed_evidence: User screenshot shows source:statement, currency and original values
contradictions: Earlier code intentionally emitted FX details and operational cashback tags; the user explicitly removed those from the display contract
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user repeatedly complained about clutter and demanded a unit-tested standardized note framework with tags always prepended.

requirements.title: Rental, shared and owner/person tagging
requirements.requirement: Assign each account/card to an owner, inherit owner reporting to transactions, use #rental plus exactly one #rental:lt713 or #rental:indigo1414 tag, and apply #shared through logical post-rules.
requirements.expected_state: Home and rental are mutually exclusive; owner, property and shared dashboards can filter reliably.
acceptance_criteria: Shared rules and owner reports populated
claimed_evidence: User specified exact rental tag format
contradictions: User first requested only #rental:unit then corrected it to separate #rental and #rental:unit tags

requirements.title: Modern envelope budgets, savings goals, and cleanup pools
requirements.requirement: Use Actual budget automation for monthly/annual budgets, scheduled bills, savings goals, rollover buckets, utility local sources/sinks, overspending pools, and end-of-month leftovers directed to saving/investing.
requirements.expected_state: Only user-approved amounts are active; recommendations remain proposals; cleanup has its own reviewed workflow separate from statement close.
acceptance_criteria: Budget templates populated for approved categories
Annual sinking funds and savings goals
Local/global cleanup fixtures in a duplicate budget
Budget formula/report cards agree with transactions
contradictions: Earlier Notion monthly/annual budget dashboards are superseded by Actual's modern bucketing system

requirements.requirement: Create schedules for utilities, subscriptions, mortgage, Sarwa transfers and card payments using dates/ranges; card due items are statement-derived one-time schedules with the New Balance, not fixed recurring amounts.
requirements.expected_state: No schedule when due date/amount evidence is absent or zero; Actual owns generated link-schedule rules.
acceptance_criteria: Statement due date preferred over forecast
Link real transfer/payment when it arrives

Configured plus-30-day due offset is forecast-only

requirements.title: Cashback is a separate live companion service

requirements.title: Fully configuration-driven public/reusable cashback engine

No UAE card literal in engine logic

requirements.title: Valid live transactions enter buckets immediately without approval
requirements.requirement: Accepted notification transactions update spend, pace, headroom, warnings and routing immediately; remove provisional/approved UI and review gate.
requirements.expected_state: Source/reconciliation markers remain internal; statements alone finalize periods.

No provisional label or approval control
Refund reverses the appropriate current-cycle spend

requirements.source_turn_summary: The user said approving transactions served no purpose and told the agent to add them directly to buckets.

requirements.title: Statement reconciliation finalizes and resets each card period
requirements.requirement: Close each cashback card only after its statement is ingested and reconciled; replace estimated live rows with authoritative statement data, finalize history, then open the next cycle.
requirements.expected_state: Reset is issuer/card-specific and idempotent; aggregate finance close occurs after the last required card period closes.
acceptance_criteria: Reconcile live vs statement with exception report
New period opens at configured boundary
contradictions: User initially proposed reset when statement received; final rule additionally requires successful reconciliation
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user asked whether reset belongs in the statement task; the architecture makes it a separate post-readback idempotent step.

requirements.title: Correct card cycles and payment due semantics
requirements.requirement: RAK and SC close/reset on day 5 and reconcile on day 6; EI closes at month-end and reconciles day 1; payment due comes from the statement and plus-30-days is forecast only.
requirements.expected_state: Periods, alerts, history and displayed dates use each card's own cycle.
contradictions: Earlier tentative last-day cycles were replaced by the user's explicit RAK day 5, SC day 5 and EI month-end values
requirements.source_turn_summary: The user supplied final cycle days and emphasized that cashback reset equals the statement cycle.

requirements.title: Live source scope and cadence
requirements.requirement: Scan only supported live transaction notifications: RAK at 08:05 daily; SC placeholder paused. Do not scan ADCB, Wio or EI live transactions; Wio and EI are statement-only for this purpose.

contradictions: Hourly, twice-daily and evening scans were superseded by morning-only

Wio is not in cashback

requirements.title: Dynamic route graph considers all card and bucket conditions
requirements.requirement: For each spend type show ordered viable cards based on current tier gap, bucket headroom, transaction fit, net reward after FX, pace and fallback; remove ineligible branches and explain thresholds/caps.

Regression recheck is still needed after subsequent refactors

requirements.title: Mobile-first compact tabbed UI

Routing first tab fits with limited/no scrolling
Positions show each bucket by default

contradictions: Several intermediate layouts were explicitly rejected for small text, wasted space, overlap and clobbered names; only the later accepted layout is relevant

requirements.title: Card positions, tier progress, history and expected cashback

contradictions: EI formerly showed stale totals and was later changed to unlimited statement-only

requirements.title: Weekly pace and under/over warnings
requirements.requirement: Calculate spend pace against where the card should be in the current week of its cycle, warn below/above normal, and use pace in routing toward minimum tiers before close.

contradictions: Earlier generic one-week-before-close alert was refined to weekly over/under pace plus close warnings

requirements.title: Declarative web push for important routing events

contradictions: Earlier prompts instructed tasks to self-archive; repeated runs hung
